activities: driving a fire tv over adb
scoring silent failures in voice agents
vibe: A design-thinking builder focused on accessibility, who turns simulated older adults into evidence designers can actually act on.
lines: Flip through my notebook! A little cartoon of me draws each page as it unlocks.
Meet Clara, a simulated older adult. She shows designers where their voice assistants lose people.
My ultra-short script backfired: it confused Clara and caused 7 repeat requests.
Across 9,000 simulated pharmacy calls, success fell from 89% to 29% for the oldest, lowest-capacity Clara.
The scariest bug is the silent failure: the log says refill submitted, but Clara can't act on it.
Repeating the whole message word for word after "you lost me" caused 64% of failures.
Families tape over remote buttons. My load map shows which TV screen is the real problem.
